AN ACT TO AMEND THE ROYAL ASIATIC SOCIET: (INCORPORATION) ACT, NO. 6 OF 1992
WHEREAS it has become necessary, inter alia, to provide
for the Corporation to be also able to engage in its activities
more effectively and democratically and to provide for the
Corporation  to  change  the  clauses  of  the  Constitution  to
enable  the  Corporation  and  the  Council  to  carry  out  its
activities  much  more  efficiently,  smoothly  and  in  keeping
with the requirements needed to suit changing circumstances
and the needs of changing times :
AND WHEREAS the Corporation has been  required to effect
the necessary amendments to the Royal Asiatic Society of Sri
Lanka  (Incorporation)  Act  to  provide  for  the  above
requirements and it is expedient to effect such amendments.
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows :-

1.
This Act may be cited as the Royal Asiatic Society of
Sri Lanka (Incorporation)  (Amendment) Act, No. 45  of 2006.

2.
Section 4(1) of the Royal Asiatic Society of Sri Lanka
(Incorporation) Act,  is  hereby  amended  by  the  repeal  of
subsection  (1)  thereof  and  that  substitution  therefor  of  the
following :—
“(1) The affairs of the Corporation shall subject to
the rules and regulations in force for the time being of
the  Corporation  be  administered  by  a  Council
consisting of the office-bearers and such other members
elected by the Corporation.”

3.
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala
and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
